guide.step1Desc: Connect any Solana wallet (Phantom, Backpack, Seed Vault on Seeker) to get started. Your wallet is your identity on SolTrivia.
guide.step2Desc: Every wallet gets 2 lifetime entries without needing lives. Entry fee (0.0225 SOL) still applies. After that, you'll need to purchase lives to keep playing.
guide.step3Desc: Lives let you enter paid rounds. Buy in bulk: 3 for 0.03 SOL, 15 for 0.1 SOL, or 35 for 0.25 SOL. Seeker holders get discounted rates. Lives never expire.
guide.step4Desc: 4 rounds run daily (every 6 hours UTC). Each entry costs 0.02 SOL to the prize pool + 0.0025 SOL platform fee. Max 5 entries per round, 20 per day.
guide.step5Desc: Each round gives you 10 trivia questions across crypto, science, history, and more. You have 10 seconds per question — no pausing.
guide.step6Desc: Every correct answer earns 100 base points + up to 900 bonus points for speed. The faster you answer, the higher your score. Max 1,000 pts per question.
guide.step7Desc: Once a round has 5+ finishers, the entire prize pool is split among the top 5: 1st gets 50%, 2nd 20%, 3rd 15%, 4th 10%, 5th 5%. Zero platform deduction from the pot.
guide.step8Desc: Winners are posted on-chain after each round. Claim your SOL directly from the smart contract — fully verifiable and trustless.
guide.step9Desc: Create your own trivia games with custom questions, share a link, and challenge friends. Free with a Game Pass, or 0.0225 SOL per game.
guide.step10Desc: Challenge another player head-to-head in real-time. Pick your wager (0.01 to 1 SOL), answer the same questions, and the winner takes the pot.
guide.fairPlayLimits: Fair play limits: max 5 entries per round, 20 per 24 hours. 4 rounds daily (every 6h UTC).

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: SOL Trivia is a crypto-themed trivia game on the Solana blockchain. Answer questions to earn points, compete against other players, and win real SOL prizes from the prize pool each round.
faq.a2: Connect your Solana wallet, pay the entry fee (0.02 SOL + 0.0025 SOL platform fee), and answer 10 questions in 10 seconds each. Your score is based on accuracy and speed. Top 5 players win SOL prizes.
faq.a3: 100% of the prize pool goes to the top 5: 1st (50%), 2nd (20%), 3rd (15%), 4th (10%), 5th (5%). No platform cut from the pot. Winners claim directly on-chain from their Profile page.
faq.a4: There are 4 rounds per day (every 6 hours UTC: 00:00, 06:00, 12:00, 18:00). Each round has its own prize pool and leaderboard. You can enter up to 5 times per round, 20 times per 24 hours.
faq.a5: Practice mode lets you play trivia for free with no wallet required. You get 5 practice runs per day (unlimited with Game Pass). Practice uses separate questions with a 12-second timer. No prizes or leaderboard ranking.
faq.a6: Every wallet gets 2 lifetime entries without needing lives (entry fee still applies). Beyond that, you need extra lives. Buy them in 3 tiers: 3 for 0.03 SOL, 15 for 0.1 SOL, or 35 for 0.25 SOL. Purchased lives roll over indefinitely across rounds.
faq.a7: A one-time purchase ($20 USD, or $10 for Seeker holders) that unlocks: unlimited practice plays, all question categories, and free custom game creation. Pay with SOL, USDC, or SKR.
faq.a8: Create your own trivia with custom questions, share a link with friends, and compete on a per-game leaderboard. Games expire after 7 days. Players get 3 attempts each. Free to join — no SOL entry fee and no prize pool.
faq.q9: How much does it cost to create a Custom Game?
faq.a9: Game Pass holders pay only 0.0025 SOL (platform fee). Without Game Pass, it costs 0.0225 SOL (0.02 SOL creation fee + 0.0025 SOL platform fee).
faq.a10: Duels are real-time 1v1 trivia battles with SOL wagers. Pick an entry fee (0.01–1 SOL), create or join a duel, and go head-to-head with 5 questions in 10 seconds each. The winner takes the pot.
faq.a11: Both players put up the same entry fee (+ 0.0025 SOL platform fee each). The winner is determined by highest score, with time as a tiebreaker. After both finish, the smart contract is resolved on-chain and the winner can claim the prize from their Profile page.
faq.q12: What happens if my Duel expires?
faq.a12: If no opponent joins within 60 minutes, the duel expires and can be cancelled. The creator gets their entry fee refunded on-chain. You can also cancel a waiting duel at any time before an opponent joins.
faq.a13: Solana Seeker device owners who verify their Genesis Token (SGT) get: +25% XP boost on profile stats, discounted lives, $10 Game Pass (instead of $20), .skr domain as display name, and a badge on the leaderboard.
faq.q14: How does the Referral Program work?
faq.a14: Share your unique referral link from your Profile page. When someone you refer connects their wallet and completes their first paid game, you earn 1,000 XP.
faq.a15: We never have access to your private keys or seed phrases. All transactions require your explicit wallet approval. Funds go directly to the on-chain smart contract vault or revenue wallet — never to a personal address.
